written: 2026-10-31, before any solve of this study (no solve of the scripts beside it has run)
what: The BEM's error budget at A: a diagnostic, not a register entry. It changes no frozen choice and reads no measured speed.
inputs_read_before_writing: M1's margin scan: least onset x1.025, x1.0325, x1.030, x1.030; M3 stage 2 at 0.178 mm: E median 7.3e-5, max 2.3e-3, the speed with the exact series +0.0019% at phase 0

A quick least-squares fit of M1's eight floored values to U* + a eps + c h^2/eps (computed while writing this, from the record above): U* 5.59, a +7.6 /s, c -4.2 mm/s per mm; at the frozen point a regularisation term of about +0.56 and a quadrature term of about -1.23 mm/s. With a term in eps^2 added: U* 5.29, regularisation +1.38, quadrature -1.24. Two blob fractions only, so poorly determined.

The sphere's regularisation alone, computed while writing this (bem_budget.sphere_regularised_drag, before any BEM solve): drag over Stokes 1 + 0.250 eps/a + about 0.32 (eps/a)^2 (1.00250 at 0.01, 1.01339 at 0.05, 1.02842 at 0.1, 1.06265 at 0.2); converged to 1e-14 between two quadratures; eps -> 0 gives Stokes to 2.5e-5 at eps/a 1e-4. Blake's system passed its checks (no slip 4e-15, divergence 6e-14, reciprocity 1e-15; the flipped doublet fails no slip at 1.29).

definitions.h: the BEM's own mean spacing (the square root of the samples' area over their count); eps = blob x h
definitions.A's speed: A0f's reading at A (a0f_statics.readings, the torque variant, script A's uniform field, both senses' mean), from the eight phases' resistances: M1's and stage 1's quantity (4.9290 mm/s at 0.16 mm, blob 0.5). Per-phase axial speeds are reported beside it.
definitions.phases: all eight at every level (the budget allows it); ordered least margin first (phase 6: the least onset of the scan at every level of M1, alone at 0.2 mm), then the lock's (phase 0: the largest effective turning resistance R_OO - R_xO^2/R_xx at 0.16 mm, so the largest lag: this reading's definition, stated here)
definitions.near the wall: a sample nearer the tube's wall than 0.6 mm (item 1 also at 0.4 and 0.8 mm)
definitions.regularised image: Blake's plane-wall image with each image singularity regularised by the free part's blob (bem_budget.blake), in the tangent plane at the source's foot, added as (regularised - point) to the table's image on every pair of near-wall samples. One regularised form, not the unique one: it differs from the exact blob-smoothing of Blake's solution at O(eps^2/h^2), its no-slip residual is reported

the_fit.data: per case, the 20 values at 4 spacings x 5 blob fractions: A's speed (tube), A's axial speed (free space), the free sphere's drag over Stokes, the tube sphere's drag over 6 pi mu a
the_fit.primary_model: B: U = U* + a eps + d eps^2 + c h^2/eps (a regularisation term in eps and eps^2; a quadrature term h^2/eps, the self-patch's error as the blob falls below the spacing)
the_fit.alternates: A: U* + a eps + c h^2/eps; C: U* + a eps + d eps^2 + c h^2/eps + e h^2. All three are fitted and reported.
the_fit.uncertainty: the least-squares standard errors (residual variance x (X^T X)^-1); k = 2. The residuals are model inadequacy, not noise, so this sigma is a heuristic, labelled so.
the_fit.split_at_A: at the frozen point (0.16 mm, blob 0.5): regularisation = a eps + d eps^2, quadrature = c h^2/eps, each with its sigma; 'dominates' when the larger magnitude exceeds the smaller by more than 2 sigma of the difference
the_fit.control_rule: the split at A is reported as a result only if the chosen model (B, else the first of A, C that passes) recovers, on the free sphere, (i) its regularisation term at the frozen point's eps within 2 sigma of the reference (sphere_regularised_drag - 1) and (ii) its limit within 2 sigma of 1; and, on the tube sphere, its limit within 2 sigma of Haberman & Sayre's K(0.3) = 2.36970 (Bohlin's series 2.36973). The tube sphere's split has no independent reference: only its limit is a known answer, and that is said, not hidden. If no model passes, the split at A is not reported as a result.
the_fit.no_off_axis_control: MIME holds no published off-axis near-wall sphere value (tests/ searched for one): that control is absent.
